column3: NASB supplies “about You”; “restore it” is rendered “revive,” and “to have compassion you will remember” “remember mercy.”
The Hebrew imperfect and perfects are rendered as present.
“Two horns” is rendered “rays flashing,” and “like the light” “like the sunlight.”
“Lightning” is rendered “plague,” and “to his feet” “after Him.”
“Shook” is rendered “surveyed,” and “made jump” “startled”; “bowed down” is rendered “collapsed.”
“Has it burned, O LORD” is rendered “Did the LORD rage.”
“Oaths of arrows, a word” is rendered “The rods of chastisement were sworn”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Stood still a lofty abode” is rendered “stood in their places,” and “go” “went away.”
“Foundation to neck” is rendered “from thigh to neck,” and “the chief from the house of the wicked” “the head of the house of the evil.”
“A heap of waters” is rendered “the surge of … waters.”
“Belly” is rendered “inward parts”; “under me” is rendered “in my place,” and NASB renders “that I will be quiet” as “I must wait quietly.”
NASB renders the clauses as concessive, “Though … should”; “product” is rendered “yield.”
“Does” is rendered “hinds’ feet,” and “makes tread me” “makes me walk”; the musical note is rendered “For the choir director.”
